analyte_description: Total clay is the soil separate with <0.002 mm particle diameter. Clay size carbonate is included. Total clay is reported as a weight percent of the <2 mm fraction.
Total clay is the soil separate with <0.002 mm particle diameter. Clay size carbonate is included. Total clay is reported as a weight percent of the <2 mm fraction.
Carbonate clay is the part of <0.002 mm diameter particles that are composed of carbonates. It is reported as a weight percent of the <2 mm fraction.
Carbonate clay is the part of <0.002 mm diameter particles that are composed of carbonates. It is reported as a weight percent of the <2 mm fraction.

The ratio of 15 bar H2O percent / clay percent is calculated by (W15AD or W15FM)/CLAY_TOT, reported as grams per gram, on a <2 mm base. It provides inferences about clay mineralogy and the effectiveness of dispersion in the particle size analysis.
The gravimetric percentage of 0.1 to 75 mm diameter particles is reported on a <75 mm base. Silty families have <15%, loamy families >= 15%.
Particles with >2 mm diameter are reported as a volume percent on a whole soil at 1/3 bar water tension base.
